entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It was terrible getting dragged around[n]by Sakamoto all day...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Do you think I'll have to go through this[n]on future school events as well?
It was terrible for him too.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But wasn't he the one who invited me[n]in the first place?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Th-Thanks? I guess I didn't exactly turn[n]down the invite either...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: *sigh* I don't know... It's fun hanging out[n]with Sakamoto, but he might be too[n]different from me...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Is getting a girlfriend my only way out of[n]this situation?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh well... Anyway, we need to wake up[n]early tomorrow. Let's get some sleep,[n]okay?
